title: Transporting an Eichler integral transports its scalar derivative by slash
statement: Let n∈ℕ, h:ℍ→ℂ, E:ℍ→BinaryForm ℂ n, and σ∈SL₂(ℤ). If IsEichlerIntegral n h E holds, then G(z)=binaryFormRepSL ℂ n (σ⁻¹)(E(σz)) satisfies IsEichlerIntegral n (h|_{n+2}σ) G.
lean_statement: ∀ (n : ℕ) (h : UpperHalfPlane → ℂ) (E : UpperHalfPlane → ↥(HeckeEis.BinaryForm ℂ n)) (σ : Matrix.SpecialLinearGroup (Fin 2) ℤ), HeckeEis.IsEichlerIntegral n h E → HeckeEis.IsEichlerIntegral n (SlashAction.map ((n : ℤ) + 2) σ h) (fun τ : UpperHalfPlane => ((HeckeEis.binaryFormRepSL ℂ n) σ⁻¹) (E (σ • τ)))
